gaps.gap: do_email_address_reassign is made from email_address.reassign with no narrowing (coverage.ts:196 is {} with no warning). Its input lets to='remove'. It also schedules email.remove_files (commands/email.ts:787-796). No bin, no restore. The screen itself warns "It can’t be brought back" (email-page.tsx:302-304). Offering this breaks the settled rule that the Assistant never deletes anything for good. Nothing in tools-screen-actions.ts refuses it.

gaps.gap: Real: submit_carrier_registration can't get through registration.submit. refuseUnlessAllGreen (registration.ts:128-163) needs a registration_checks row whose fingerprint matches the exact details. Only the worker's /v1/telephony/registration-preflight writes that row (server.ts:560, via registration.record_check), and no Assistant tool calls it. registrationInput (tools-settings-channels.ts:253-279) also builds a BusinessProfile without optInPath, optInUrl, displayName, policyUrl, termsUrl, policyContact, otherWays or confirmed. So even a check run on the screen never matches it. The tool's own advice to send the person to the last step to check "these exact details" can't work. Drafts are real too: withDraft reads only draft['form'] with the wizard's field names (a2p-wizard.tsx:269-292). registration.save_draft's answers are a loose record with no described shape (schemas/telephony.ts:357-362), so an Assistant draft doesn't fill in the wizard.
